entries.source: Fratris Pauli Waltheri Guglingensis Itinerarium in Terram Sanctam et ad Sanctam Catharinam, Volume 192; Volume 194, editorial notes
entries.german: Aus seinem 1632 ausgestorbenen geschlechte pilgerte noch Kunz von Rosenb. 1493 nach Palästina, starb aber auf der rückreise in Venedig. Hiernheim fand 1569 das wappen der Rosenberg in Ramle.
entries.english: From his lineage, extinct in 1632, Kunz von Rosenberg also went on pilgrimage to Palestine in 1493, but died on the return journey at Venice. Hiernheim found the arms of the Rosenberg at Ramle in 1569.

facts.content: died at Venice on the return journey from the pilgrimage to Palestine.

facts.subject: Arms of the Rosenberg
facts.content: were found at Ramle by Hiernheim.
